operational_command_center.principle: Combine ontology-backed entities, current/historical state, provenance, AI reasoning, human review, workflow actions and measured outcomes.

best_fit_model_routing.principle: Route models by measured task fitness, policy boundary, quality, cost and latency rather than by brand or model size.

deployment_as_capability.principle: Treat deployment capacity, migration, partner implementation, operator adoption, governance and value realization as first-class system objects.
